preference_summary: No teaching-style preference recorded yet. Showing a balanced set.

cards.title: The bias-variance decomposition, derived
cards.description: Work through the formal decomposition of expected error, then predict which term dominates for three model families before checking against measured error.
cards.why_suggested: Foundational result that later diagnostic work depends on.

cards.title: Build and defend a model card
cards.description: Students train a small classifier and publish a model card documenting intended use, evaluation data and known failure modes.
cards.why_suggested: Produces an artifact students can carry into later coursework.

cards.title: Audit a hiring model for disparate impact
cards.description: Students examine a documented hiring-model failure, locate where error entered the pipeline, and argue which mitigation would have caught it.
cards.why_suggested: Connects error analysis to a consequence students already recognise.

cards.title: Post-mortem: a recommender's feedback loop
cards.description: Students trace how a deployed recommender narrowed its own training distribution, then propose an intervention and predict its cost.
cards.why_suggested: Shows distribution shift as an operational problem rather than a formula.
